admission.justification: Binds all future read-boundary prose to the complete admitted-writes list, as MIK-R74 rule 8 requires.

alternatives.option: A read is every tool its description calls a read; it may write only (a) coordination runtime cache files under <coordination root>/runtime/, (b) comparison-recorded objects, the task report and one review pin, and (c) closeout-preview worklist, quality reports and judged-tree objects; no other directory is created and failures refuse by name.
alternatives.reason: The architecture's What a Read May Write states exactly this boundary; compressed reads-file-nothing sentences omit the admitted writes the packet requires.

alternatives.option: Reads, previews and dry runs file nothing.
alternatives.reason: Omits the admitted (a)/(b)/(c) writes and lets a reader infer that required reproducibility artifacts violate the policy.
alternatives.reconsider_when: The architecture's read boundary removes the admitted writes.

consequences: Future overview and route prose states the complete (a)/(b)/(c) boundary wherever it makes a general reads-file claim.
context: MIK-R74 rule 8 requires the complete rule-6 boundary as an authored decision; three general overview sentences stated reads-file-nothing without the admitted list.
